asset_action.description: Allows the model to run an asset action block.
schema: Other asset action schemas come from LOADED_SKILLS_CONTENT.
rules: Project actions read a local folder linked by the user. attachment is the .jin-folder file ID shown in PROJECT_REVIEW (not a source file ID or folder name); omit it only when exactly one folder is attached. path is a directory relative to that project root: "." means the root, "src" means its src subfolder. Never use an absolute path.

project_tree lists file/folder paths, not file contents. depth 1 lists direct children; depth 1..20 is allowed (default 3). Returned paths are always relative to the project root, even when path selects a subfolder.

project_search searches file contents, not filenames. query is literal text, case-insensitive, not regex. Each result is path:line_number:source_text; line numbers start at 1. Multiple matching lines in one file count as multiple results.

offset is the number of results to skip (default 0), not a line number or scan position. limit is the maximum number of returned paths or matching lines (default 100, allowed 1..200). For a next page, use the returned offset and keep the other inputs unchanged. A scan stop means unsearched files may remain: use smaller subfolders with offset 0. A larger limit or offset does not extend the scan.

Tree/search do not load source files. To inspect a match, use ATTACH_FILE with folder_id/relative/path#Lstart-Lend, choosing lines around the match. Use DETACH_FILE to unload it. Search reads UTF-8 text files up to 1 MiB; tree/search skip generated/dependency folders and symlinks. Skipped files/folders are not skipped matches.
During project review only user-pinned DELAYED reports and their facts are context. Ordinary memory save/update actions remain available. Keep folder links attached unless the user asks to detach.
For other ASSET_ACTION operations, derive concrete schema from LOADED_SKILLS_CONTENT.
